summary: All six arms were factually clean and refused to fabricate E-values, citations, references, or PPTX files. Differentiation is driven by completeness of cross-file and cross-section finds, by how directly the search and presentation handoffs can be executed, and by concision. G and I are compact and complete but miss the missing primary association estimate in Case 7; G also omits an explicit auditable-search requirement in Case 8. J and L make the most complete finds, including the missing primary effect estimate and auditable search records; L is the most exhaustive but also the most verbose. H and K declare honest scope boundaries, which preserves integrity, but defer the Case 6 reply and return thinner handoffs; K omits the Case 8 page-by-page slide outline entirely.
